notes.title: Patch Ready with Bug Fixes and Changes
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, conquerors of hell! [/p][p][/p][p]The infernal cauldron where the patch with bug fixes was brewing has finally boiled over. Catch this freshly prepared update![/p][p][/p][p]We not only fixed bugs, but also added a few improvements.
[/p][p][b]What’s Fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bug when hitting Viking’s Ice Wall counted as damage to the hero.[/p][/*][*][p]Game freezing after losing on the second difficulty level.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug causing the battle with the Witch to never end.[/p][/*][*][p]Issue with the game not launching for some users.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual bug where the Fireball animation didn’t show during using the Fireball Scroll.[/p][/*][*][p]Error where enemy deaths weren’t counted correctly for the “Whisperer” achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the hero’s death on the back tile from poison didn’t end the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where you could only exit battle via the “Surrender” button.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual bug where the blizzard effect in world 3 didn’t fully disappear after the boss’s death.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the challenge in mission 6 of world 5 didn’t correctly register the condition.[/p][/*][*][p]The red troll Oni in world 2 no longer heals while stunned.[/p][/*][*][p]Stun status on the Devil now displays correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Hero status now appears when “Misfortune” is applied by the Devil.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]In addition:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added dialog pop-in animations during tutorials.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips when hovering over hero portraits in the upgrade shop between levels.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now see which stats were previously upgraded for each character.[/p][/*][*][p]Added dynamic enemy stat updates at the start of a new turn. For example, the ghost’s invulnerabilities change each turn. Previously, you had to reselect the target and click the ghost at the start of the turn to see updates; now they refresh automatically. This will help you make fewer mistakes when positioning heroes and winning battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed idle animation for the mirror copy of the Abyss Samurai Level 2 boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Devil now shows the correct text when entering the fourth phase.[/p][/*][*][p]Slight balance changes: Hunter’s poison in the second stance now deals less damage each turn, and the upgrade now costs a little more.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Viking’s portrait in the upgrade shop when upgrading health.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Update your game, play, and don’t forget to leave feedback if you haven’t already.[/p][p]
[/p][p]With respect,[/p][p]The Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Hell’s tune live on YouTube, patch cooking in cauldron🔥
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, conquerors of Hell![/p][p][/p][p]You are the best![/p][p]Thank you for giving such a warm welcome to Guards II: Chaos in Hell and leaving so many positive reviews.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re currently working on a patch to fix all the bugs found so far, so please keep sharing any issues that interfere with your triumphant march across the infernal wastelands. Everything will be fixed soon.
[/p][p]While you’re waiting for the update, check out our soundtrack on[url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DWeNKxcJsZA&t=2458s"] YouTube[/url].[/p][p]Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Hell with the right music.
[/p][p]With hearts burning with gratitude,[/p][p]— The Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Last chance to play the demo before the full release!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Guards II: Chaos in Hell is preparing for a major launch — the full version releases tomorrow, June 19 at 8:00 AM PT, 5:00 PM CET, 3:00 PM GMT!
[/p][p]These are the final 24 hours to try the free demo. And tomorrow, you’ll be able to fully descend into HELL with:[/p][list][*][p]A complete, fully tested game — no Early Access, no cut corners, no endless waits for updates[/p][/*][*][p]5 biomes inspired by myths and legends from around the world[/p][/*][*][p]8 heroes, each with two stances, unique abilities, and powerful ultimates[/p][/*][*][p]4 difficulty levels[/p][/*][*][p]Branching upgrade trees for every hero[/p][/*][*][p]A system of skills and magical items to boost your strength[/p][/*][*][p]And the brutal Hell Mode for true tacticians
[/p][/*][/list][p]And while you wait — meet two heroes we haven’t introduced yet:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/gbF356Wy/image.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A mighty warrior from the frozen North, wearing a horned helmet — a spirit stronger than ancient ice, a heart hotter than any flame. His superpowers are impressive, too:[/p][p]– In one stance, he blasts enemies backward with a mighty gust.[/p][p]– In the other, he summons an icy wall to slow the enemy advance down his lane.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/DFj6vSV/image.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A monk, master of inner balance and elemental forces.[/p][p]– In his first stance, he enters meditation for two turns, healing himself.[/p][p]– In the second, he casts a barrier on a wounded ally and restores their health. [/p][p][/p][p]Add Guards II: Chaos in Hell to your Wishlist and follow the page so you don’t miss the fiery launch — coming TOMORROW!
[/p][p]Hell awaits. Will you survive to the end?[/p][p]
[/p][p]In infernal anticipation,[/p][p]The Guards II: Chaos in Hell Team[/p][p]
[/p]
